# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.9

Activation-order fix for DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`.

## Fixed

- Fixed Web boot failure when this plugin activates before `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-schedule`.
- `dsh.client.inject` is no longer treated as an activation-order guarantee.
- The plugin now waits for the live native `schedule.manager` registration before shadowing `main:schedules`.
- Missing native schedule UI during early activation no longer throws or marks the plugin failed.
- Native schedule unload/reload (including HMR-style redeclaration) disposes and recreates the enhanced main panel safely.

## Architecture retained

- Enhanced Automation tasks cards, search, filters and grouping stay owned by this plugin.
- Rules and Delivery records continue to use the shipped DSH TaskManagerPage/TaskDetail bridge.
- Delivery popup, unread attention, overdue warning and sidebar summary remain unchanged.

## Tests

- Added an executable activation-order regression: plugin-first boot, delayed native schedule registration, duplicate notifications, native unload and re-registration.
- Existing package, bundle and DSH install/boot smoke checks remain enabled.
